default.en: Karana not classified — treated as neutral.

meta.note: karana_index: 0 Bava, 1 Balava, 2 Kaulava, 3 Taitila, 4 Gara, 5 Vanija, 6 Vishti (the seven movable), 7 Shakuni, 8 Chatushpada, 9 Naga, 10 Kimstughna (the four fixed).

translations.en: Bava — movable karana, auspicious for beginnings.
translations.hi: बव — चर करण, आरम्भ हेतु शुभ।

rules.interpretation: The first of the movable karanas; favourable for all auspicious work.
Favourable, particularly for domestic and brahminical acts.

translations.en: Kaulava — movable karana; favours friendship and union.
translations.hi: कौलव — चर करण; मैत्री व सम्बन्ध हेतु उत्तम।

rules.interpretation: Classically linked with alliance and conjugal harmony, so it ranks highest here.

translations.en: Gara — movable karana; suited to sowing and agriculture, middling here.
translations.hi: गर — चर करण; कृषि हेतु उपयुक्त, यहाँ मध्यम।

rules.interpretation: Not rejected, but its natural signification is agricultural rather than samskaric.

translations.en: Vanija — movable karana; suited to trade, acceptable here.
translations.hi: वणिज — चर करण; व्यापार हेतु उपयुक्त, यहाँ ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Commercially favourable; neutral for a samskara.

translations.en: Vishti (Bhadra) — all auspicious work is forbidden while Bhadra rules.
translations.hi: विष्टि (भद्रा) — भद्राकाल में समस्त शुभ कार्य वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra is the most emphatic karana prohibition in muhurta. Note that Bhadra occupies only part of the civil day; the engine flags the whole day because it evaluates dates, not moments — the expanded detail should tell the user to check the Bhadra window.

translations.en: Shakuni — fixed karana; only medicinal and remedial acts are advised.
translations.hi: शकुनि — स्थिर करण; केवल औषध व शान्ति कर्म हेतु।

rules.interpretation: One of the four fixed karanas clustered around Amavasya; unsuited to beginnings.

translations.en: Chatushpada — fixed karana; suited to cattle and shraddha, not to conception.
translations.hi: चतुष्पद — स्थिर करण; गो-कर्म व श्राद्ध हेतु, गर्भाधान हेतु नहीं।

rules.interpretation: Falls in the second half of Krishna Chaturdashi, already a prohibited tithi.

translations.en: Naga — fixed karana; inauspicious for auspicious beginnings.
translations.hi: नाग — स्थिर करण; शुभारम्भ हेतु अशुभ।

rules.interpretation: Occupies the first half of Amavasya; only cruel or remedial acts are indicated.

translations.en: Kimstughna — fixed karana of the second half of Amavasya into Pratipada; weak.

rules.interpretation: Considered mildly auspicious by some, but it always coincides with the very weak Moon around Amavasya.
